import numpy as np
knots=np.linspace(0.5,12,14)
def hat(x):
    H=[]
    for i,k in enumerate(knots):
        l=knots[i-1] if i>0 else k-1; r=knots[i+1] if i<len(knots)-1 else k+1
        h=np.where((x>=l)&(x<=k),(x-l)/(k-l+1e-12),0)+np.where((x>k)&(x<=r),(r-x)/(r-k+1e-12),0)
        H.append(h)
    return np.column_stack(H)

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    A = params[0] + params[1]*t*np.exp(-params[2]*t) + params[3]*np.sin(params[9]*t) + params[4]*np.cos(params[9]*t)
    return A/P + params[5]*P**2 + params[6]*P*np.log(P) + params[7] + params[8]*t
